items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I taught him a few good steps he could use.

ctx.x: I taught him a few good steps he could use. I think he was satisfied. And while I was teaching him, I got a chance to show the things to Marilyn Miller who was a friend of his that he brought along as a guest and I noticed in her dancing she was more apt to catch a step than he was, so I wanted to show it to her, so he'd get more for his money that he was going to get because he was slowing up to me for what I had to show him, because it would take him longer to get it, 'cause I had some intricate steps at that…
So she learned it and she took off to show it to him, wherever he wanted to go to do it, you know. So they did.
